author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! Surprising developments in the world are happening where new foreign routers (basically all of them) just got banned. I can't understand the reasoning behind this but it's worrying when you look at the future of how you run a network in your own home. It seems the future will have you buying only the approved hardware (even if they also spy on you).
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: All Foreign Routers Just Got BANNED Today...
